To find the product of 17 and 23, we can use the standard multiplication algorithm or the distributive property.

**Method 1: Standard Multiplication**
$$
\begin{array}{r@{\quad}l}
  17 & \\
\times 23 & \\
\hline
  51 & \leftarrow 17 \times 3 \\
 340 & \leftarrow 17 \times 20 \\
\hline
 391 & \\
\end{array}
$$
Calculation steps:
1. $17 \times 3 = 51$
2. $17 \times 20 = 340$
3. $51 + 340 = 391$

**Method 2: Distributive Property**
$$17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3)$$
$$= (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3)$$
$$= 340 + 51$$
$$= 391$$

<answer>391</answer>
